claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows front panel text reading 'bizhub PRO C754e' and 'KONICA MINOLTA' logo.
Witness read the front panel label as 'bizhub PRO C754e', not C854e; the two are different Konica Minolta models with different specs/values.
No test print, internal toner, or spec plate close-up shown to confirm color capability or laser engine; inferred only from external body, which is not proof.

risks.risk: Model identity mismatch (C754e vs seller's claimed C854e) could mean wrong unit, mislabeled listing, or attempt to misrepresent a higher-spec model.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate/serial sticker (usually inside a side panel or near the control board) showing exact model and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lower-confirmed model (C754e) per witness reading, not the seller's claimed C854e.

risks.risk: Unknown page/usage counter reading, which heavily affects value of large-volume production printers.
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the control panel counter/meter screen.

risks.risk: Unknown power-on/functional status after outdoor storage.
risks.proof: Short video clip of the unit powering on, screen booting, and a test print or copy.

risks.risk: Possible internal damage from outdoor/concrete storage (moisture, dust, pest ingress).
risks.proof: Photos of internal compartments (toner/drum unit, fuser area) and surrounding storage environment over time.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing full servicing before resale.

risks.risk: Incomplete accessories (toner cartridges, trays, cables, finisher units).
risks.proof: Photos of all paper trays opened, toner compartment, and any cable bundle included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bare unit only, no consumables or accessories.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition of rear/sides unknown, may hide damage or missing covers.
risks.proof: Photos of rear and both side panels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worst-case (visible damage assumed).

risks.risk: Plastic wrap suggests unit may be new/refurbished stock rather than used as implied, or conversely may be reused packaging hiding prior damage.
risks.proof: Photo showing full unwrapped unit and any 'refurbished' or 'used' tags/stickers.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the nameplate/serial number sticker confirming exact model.
Photo or video of the control panel usage/page counter.
Video of the machine powering on and producing a test print/copy.
Photos of all paper trays opened and toner/drum compartment.
Photos of rear and side panels.
Photo of any accessories, cables, or manuals included.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the unit as a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e from the front panel, so it can be priced at worst case despite the seller's conflicting model claim and several unverified functional/cosmetic risks.
